actor: ML-supply-chain security researcher hunting deserialization-RCE primitives

actor: Open-source ML-infra maintainer of a feature store or model/artifact registry
job: Shipping and extending a registry that accepts serialized transformation logic over the network and hands it to a deserializer, keeping the unsafe-on-the-wire primitive in production by default.

motivation: Backward compatibility, developer ergonomics, and feature velocity keep pickle/dill-style serialization on the wire because safe-format migration is disruptive and unfunded.
